questions.text: स्थिर वित्तीय व्ययों जैसे ब्याज का भुगतान तथा अन्य दायित्वों के पुनर्भुगतान में असमर्थता सम्बन्धी जोखिम जाना जाता है :
questions.text_english: The risk related to inability to meet fixed financial charges like interest payment and other repayment obligations is known as :

options.B: वित्तीय जोखिम
options.D: उपरोक्त में से कोई नहीं

questions.solution: The correct answer is (B) Financial risk. Financial risk refers to the risk arising from the inability of a firm to meet its fixed financial obligations such as interest payments on debt and repayment of loans. Option (A) Operating risk relates to day-to-day business operations, while (C) Business risk refers to the uncertainty about earnings from operations. Option (D) is incorrect as a specific term exists.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (B) वित्तीय जोखिम है। वित्तीय जोखिम वह जोखिम है जो तब उत्पन्न होता है जब कोई फर्म अपने स्थिर वित्तीय दायित्वों जैसे ऋण पर ब्याज भुगतान और ऋण पुनर्भुगतान को पूरा करने में असमर्थ होती है।

questions.text: बिमल रॉय फनी बनी लिमिटेड में कार्यरत है। कम्पनी बच्चों के खेल एवं खिलौने बनाती है। बिमल रॉय का मुख्य कार्य विभिन्न तत्त्वों में एकता तथा विभिन्न विभागों के कायों में सामंजस्य स्थापित करना है। वह फर्म के जीवन के लिए व्यवसाय के पर्यावरण एवं उसके प्रभाव का विश्लेषण भी करता है। प्रबन्ध का वह स्तर जिस पर बिमल रॉय कार्यरत है, वह है
questions.text_english: Bimal Rai is working in Funny Bunny Ltd. The company manufactures games and toys for children. The basic task of Bimal Rai is to integrate diverse elements and coordinate the activities of different departments. He also analyses the business environment and its implications for the survival of the firm. The level of management at which Bimal Rai is working is :

options.B: मध्य स्तर
options.D: दोनों मध्यम एवं प्रचालन स्तर

questions.solution: The correct answer is (A) Top level management. Top-level managers are responsible for integrating diverse elements, coordinating activities of all departments, and analysing the business environment for the firm's survival. These are strategic functions performed by the Board of Directors, CEO etc. Middle level managers implement policies and Operational level managers supervise day-to-day work, so (B), (C), and (D) are incorrect.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (A) उच्च स्तर है। उच्च स्तरीय प्रबन्धक विभिन्न तत्त्वों में एकता स्थापित करने, विभागों में समन्वय करने तथा व्यावसायिक पर्यावरण के विश्लेषण जैसी रणनीतिक जिम्मेदारियाँ निभाते हैं।

questions.text: सलीम तथा करीम अच्छे दोस्त हैं। जैविक सब्जियाँ उगाने के लिए उन्होंने उच्च गुणवत्ता वाले बीजों के विक्रय का व्यवसाय प्रारम्भ किया। वे सब्जियों के बीजों की 200 किस्में प्रस्तावित कर रहे हैं जो छतों पर, बालकनी तथा घर के पिछले भागों में उद्यान लगाने के लिए उपयुक्त हैं। स्वस्थ उपभोग आदतों के प्रति बढ़ती हुई प्रवृत्ति के कारण, उनके बीजों की माँग काफी अधिक है। उपरोक्त में चर्चित व्यावसायिक पर्यावरण का आयाम है :
questions.text_english: Salim and Karim are good friends. They started a business of selling high quality seeds for growing organic vegetables. They are offering 200 varieties of vegetable seeds suitable for terrace gardens, balconies and backyards. Due to the growing trend towards healthy consumption habits, there is a huge demand for their seeds. The dimension of business environment being discussed above is :

options.B: राजनैतिक पर्यावरण
options.D: कानूनी/वैधिक पर्यावरण

questions.solution: The correct answer is (C) Social Environment. The growing trend towards healthy consumption habits reflects a change in social attitudes, values and lifestyles of consumers, which is a component of the social environment. Economic environment relates to income and inflation, political environment deals with government policies, and legal environment covers laws and regulations. Hence options (A), (B), and (D) are incorrect.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (C) सामाजिक पर्यावरण है। स्वस्थ उपभोग आदतों के प्रति बढ़ती प्रवृत्ति सामाजिक मूल्यों एवं जीवनशैली में परिवर्तन को दर्शाती है जो सामाजिक पर्यावरण का भाग है।

questions.text: श्रीधन एक इलेक्ट्रिक कार खरीदना चाहता है। वह एक कार कम्पनी के खुदरा शोरूम में गया जहाँ इन कारों का प्रदर्शन किया गया था। इस शोरूम के विपणन प्रबन्धक ने श्रीधन को बताया कि कम्पनी ऋण सुविधा, रखरखाव की सुविधा तथा अन्य बहुत-सी सुविधाएँ प्रदान करती है जो बार-बार क्रय करने तथा उनकी कारों के प्रति ब्राण्ड निष्ठा विकसित करने में सहायता करती है। उपरोक्त स्थिति में विपणन प्रबन्धक द्वारा चर्चित विपणन का कार्य है :
questions.text_english: Shridhan wanted to purchase an electric car. He visited a retail showroom of a car company where these cars were displayed. The Marketing Manager of this showroom told Shridhan that the company offers credit facilities, maintenance services and many other services that help in bringing repeat sales and developing brand loyalty for their cars. The marketing function being discussed by the Marketing Manager in the above case is

options.B: विपणन नियोजन
options.D: ब्राण्डिंग

questions.solution: The correct answer is (C) Customer Support Services. The marketing manager is describing after-sales services like credit facilities, maintenance services etc. that build customer satisfaction, encourage repeat purchases and develop brand loyalty — all hallmarks of Customer Support Services. Product designing relates to creating the product, Marketing Planning involves strategy, and Branding involves creating brand identity, so (A), (B), and (D) are incorrect.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (C) ग्राहक समर्थन सेवाएँ है। ऋण सुविधा, रखरखाव सेवाएँ आदि विक्रय-पश्चात सेवाएँ हैं जो ग्राहक संतोष और ब्राण्ड निष्ठा बढ़ाती हैं।

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा कथन विपणन की विशेषता 'विनिमय पद्धति' के सम्बन्ध में सही है ?
questions.text_english: Which of the following statement is correct with respect to 'Exchange Mechanism', a feature of Marketing ?

options.A: विनिमय के लिए कम-से-कम तीन पक्षों की भागीदारी होनी आवश्यक है।
options.B: प्रत्येक पक्ष को अन्य पक्षों के प्रस्ताव को अस्वीकार करने की स्वतंत्रता नहीं होनी चाहिए।
options.C: प्रत्येक पक्ष को प्रस्ताव को स्वीकार करने की बाध्यता होनी चाहिए।
options.D: विनिमय के लिए प्रत्येक पक्ष का दूसरे पक्ष को कोई मूल्ययुक्त वस्तु देने में सक्षम होना आवश्यक है।

options_english.A: For an exchange it is necessary that there should be involvement of at least three parties.
options_english.B: The parties do not have the freedom to reject other parties offer.
options_english.C: The acceptance of the offer for each party has to take place on the basis of compulsion.
options_english.D: For an exchange it is necessary that each party should be capable of offering something of value to the other.

questions.solution: The correct answer is (D). A fundamental condition of exchange in marketing is that each party must have something of value to offer to the other. Option (A) is wrong because exchange requires at least two parties, not three. Option (B) is wrong because parties must have the freedom to reject. Option (C) is wrong because acceptance must be voluntary, not compulsory.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (D) है। विनिमय की मूल शर्त यह है कि प्रत्येक पक्ष दूसरे को कोई मूल्ययुक्त वस्तु प्रदान करने में सक्षम हो। (A) गलत है क्योंकि कम से कम दो पक्ष चाहिए।

questions.text: एक जागरूक उपभोक्ता के विभिन्न उत्तरदायित्वों में से एक है केवल मानकीकृत वस्तुएँ खरीदना क्योंकि ये गुणवत्ता का आश्वासन प्रदान करती हैं। नीचे दिए गए चित्र में एक उपभोक्ता द्वारा देखे जाने वाले गुणवत्ता प्रमाणक मार्क को पहचानिए :
questions.text_english: One of the responsibilities of an aware consumer is to buy only standardised goods as they provide quality assurance. Identify the quality certification mark to be seen by a consumer in the picture given below :

options.B: एगमार्क
options.D: एफ पी ओ/एफ एस एस ए आई मार्क

questions.solution: The correct answer is (A) ISI Mark. The picture shows an electric iron, which is an electrical appliance. The ISI Mark is issued by the Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) and is the quality certification mark for industrial products, especially electrical goods. Agmark is for agricultural products, Hallmark is for gold and jewellery, and FPO/FSSAI Mark is for processed food products, so (B), (C), and (D) are incorrect.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (A) आई एस आई मार्क है। चित्र में विद्युत इस्त्री दिखाई गई है जो एक विद्युत उपकरण है। ISI मार्क भारतीय मानक ब्यूरो द्वारा औद्योगिक एवं विद्युत उत्पादों के लिए दिया जाता है।

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा भारतीय प्रतिभूति एवं विनिमय बोर्ड का सुरक्षात्मक कार्य नहीं है :
questions.text_english: Which of the following is not a protective function of Securities and Exchange Board of India :

options.A: धोखाधड़ी एवं अनुचित व्यापार व्यवहारों पर प्रतिबंध लगाती है।
options.B: भीतरी/आंतरिक व्यापार पर नियंत्रण करना तथा इस प्रकार के व्यवहारों पर दंड लगाना।
options.C: प्रतिभूति बाज़ार में उचित व्यवहारों एवं आचार-संहिता को बढ़ावा देना।
options.D: लचीला दृष्टिकोण अपनाकर पूँजी बाज़ार को विकसित करने के लिए कदम उठाना।

options_english.A: Prohibition of fraudulent and unfair trade practices.
options_english.B: Controlling insider trading and imposing penalties for such practices.
options_english.C: Promotion of fair practices and code of conduct in securities market.
options_english.D: Undertaking measures to develop the capital markets by adapting a flexible approach.

questions.solution: The correct answer is (D). Developing the capital market by adopting a flexible approach is a Developmental function of SEBI, not a Protective function. Protective functions of SEBI include prohibiting fraudulent trade practices (A), controlling insider trading (B), and promoting fair practices (C). Hence options (A), (B), and (C) are all protective functions, making (D) the correct choice as the odd one out.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (D) है। पूँजी बाज़ार को विकसित करना SEBI का विकासपूर्ण कार्य है, सुरक्षात्मक कार्य नहीं। धोखाधड़ी पर प्रतिबंध, भीतरी व्यापार नियंत्रण और उचित व्यवहारों का प्रोत्साहन सुरक्षात्मक कार्य हैं।

questions.text:
यहाँ दो कथन दिए गए हैं, अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R)।
अभिकथन (A) : लीड टाइम जितना अधिक होगा माल को उतनी ही अधिक मात्रा में संगृहित करने की आवश्यकता होगी तथा उतनी ही अधिक कार्यशील पूँजी की आवश्यकता होगी।
कारण (R) : यदि कच्चा माल निर्विघ्न रूप में उपलब्ध नहीं होता है तो कच्चे माल के भारी स्टॉक की आवश्यकता होगी।
नीचे दिए गए विकल्पों में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
questions.text_english:
There are two Statements, Assertion (A) and Reason (R).
Assertion (A) : Larger the lead time, larger is the quantity of material required to be stored and larger shall be the amount of working capital required.
Reason (R) : If the raw material do not have a record of un-interrupted availability, higher stock levels may be required.
Choose the correct alternative from the alternatives given below :

options.A: अभिकथन (A) असत्य है तथा कारण (R) सत्य है।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R) दोनों असत्य हैं।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सत्य है तथा कारण (R) असत्य है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं तथा कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या है।

options_english.A: Assertion (A) is false and Reason (R) is true.
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are false.
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true and Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).

questions.solution: The correct answer is (D). Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, and Reason (R) correctly explains Assertion (A). When lead time is longer, more inventory must be kept to ensure continuous production, thus requiring more working capital. The reason correctly explains that if raw material supply is not uninterrupted, higher stock levels must be maintained — which directly causes the situation described in the assertion.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (D) है। अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं और कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या करता है। अधिक लीड टाइम से अधिक स्टॉक रखना पड़ता है और कारण इसकी सटीक व्याख्या करता है।

questions.text: वैयक्तिक विक्रय के सम्बन्ध में निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा कथन सही है :
questions.text_english: Which of the following statement is correct about personal selling :

options.A: यह सम्प्रेषण का अवैयक्तिक रूप है।
options.B: वैयक्तिक विक्रय विक्रयकर्त्ताओं को संभावित उपभोक्ताओं के साथ व्यक्तिगत सम्बन्ध विकसित करने की अनुमति नहीं देता।
options.C: वैयक्तिक विक्रय में विक्रय के उद्देश्य से एक या अधिक संभावित उपभोक्ताओं के साथ संदेश की मौखिक प्रस्तुति सम्मिलित है।
options.D: वैयक्तिक विक्रय से तात्पर्य लघु अवधि प्रेरणाओं से है, जो क्रेताओं को वस्तु अथवा सेवाओं के तुरंत क्रय करने के लिए प्रेरित करने के लिए होती हैं।

options_english.A: It is an impersonal form of communication.
options_english.B: Personal selling does not allow a sales person to develop personal relationships with the prospective customers.
options_english.C: Personal selling involves oral presentation of message in the form of conversation with one or more prospective customers for the purpose of making a sale.
options_english.D: Personal selling refers to short-term incentives, which are designed to encourage the buyers to make immediate purchase of a product or service.

questions.solution: The correct answer is (C). Personal selling is defined as an oral presentation through conversation with one or more prospective buyers for the purpose of making sales. It is a personal form of communication (not impersonal), so (A) is wrong. It does allow developing personal relationships, so (B) is wrong. Option (D) describes sales promotion, not personal selling, so (D) is wrong.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (C) है। वैयक्तिक विक्रय में विक्रय के उद्देश्य से संभावित ग्राहकों के साथ बातचीत के रूप में मौखिक प्रस्तुति शामिल है। (A) गलत है क्योंकि यह वैयक्तिक संप्रेषण है। (D) विक्रय संवर्धन का वर्णन है।

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित दो कथनों अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) को पढ़िए :
अभिकथन (A) : समन्वय कार्यवाही में एकता लाता है।
कारण (R) : समन्वय विभागों को जोड़ने की शक्ति का कार्य करता है तथा यह सुनिश्चित करता है कि सभी क्रियाएँ संगठन के लक्ष्यों को प्राप्त करने के उद्देश्य से की जाती हैं।
नीचे दिए गए विकल्पों में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
questions.text_english:
There are two statements, Assertion (A) and Reason (R) :
Assertion (A) : Coordination ensures unity of action.
Reason (R) : Coordination act as a binding force between departments and ensures that all action is aimed at achieving the goals of the organisation.
Choose the correct alternative from the alternatives given below :

options.A: अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R) दोनों सही हैं तथा कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या है।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R) दोनों सही हैं, लेकिन कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सही है, लेकिन कारण (R) गलत है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) गलत है, लेकिन कारण (R) सही है।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are correct and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are correct, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is correct, but Reason (R) is wrong.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is wrong, but Reason (R) is correct.

questions.solution: The correct answer is (A). Both statements are correct. Coordination does ensure unity of action (Assertion A is correct), and the Reason correctly explains how — by acting as a binding force between departments and directing all actions towards organisational goals. Since Reason (R) directly and logically explains Assertion (A), option (A) is the right choice.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (A) है। दोनों कथन सत्य हैं और कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या करता है। समन्वय एकता लाता है क्योंकि यह विभागों को जोड़ता है और सभी क्रियाओं को लक्ष्यों की ओर निर्देशित करता है।

questions.text: अनौपचारिक संगठन में अधिकार _________ उत्पन्न होते हैं।
questions.text_english: In an informal organisation, authority arises out of _________.

options.A: प्रबन्ध के स्तर की क्षमता के अनुसार
options.B: कम्पनी के नियमों एवं नीतियों से
options.D: व्यक्तिगत गुणों से

questions.solution: The correct answer is (D) Personal qualities. In an informal organisation, authority and influence arise from the personal qualities of an individual such as expertise, charisma, and interpersonal skills — not from any official position. In a formal organisation, authority comes from position (A), company rules (B), or the scalar chain (C), but the informal organisation is not bound by these formal structures.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (D) व्यक्तिगत गुणों से है। अनौपचारिक संगठन में अधिकार व्यक्ति के व्यक्तिगत गुणों जैसे विशेषज्ञता, करिश्मा आदि से उत्पन्न होते हैं, न कि पद या नियमों से।

questions.text: एचजी एयर कंडीशनर प्राइवेट लिमिटेड अपने निर्धारित उत्पादन लक्ष्य से एक माह पीछे चल रही है। उच्च माँग होने के बावजूद कम्पनी अपने उत्पादन लक्ष्यों को प्राप्त करने के लिए संघर्ष कर रही है। कर्मचारियों का प्रशिक्षण, परियोजना के लिए अतिरिक्त संयंत्र एवं कर्मचारियों की नियुक्ति जैसे कदम उठाने के बाद भी लक्ष्यों की प्राप्ति नहीं हो सकी है। अब उत्पादन प्रबन्धक ने मानकों को संशोधित करने का निर्णय लिया है। नियंत्रण प्रक्रिया के उस चरण को पहचानिए जिसके अन्तर्गत उत्पादन प्रबन्धक ने मानकों को संशोधित करने का निर्णय लिया है।
questions.text_english: HG Air Conditioner Pvt. Ltd. is lagging behind its scheduled production target by a month. Despite a high demand, the company is struggling to meet its production target. Even after taking measures like training of employees and assigning additional workers and equipment to the project, the targets could not be met. The Production Manager, now, decided to revise the standards. Identify the step of the controlling process under which the Production Manager decided to revise the standards.

options.B: वास्तविक निष्पादन की माप
options.D: सुधारात्मक कार्यवाही करना

questions.solution: The correct answer is (A) Setting performance standards. When corrective actions (training, additional staff, equipment) are taken but targets still cannot be met, the manager revises the standards. Revising or resetting standards is part of the first step of the controlling process — Setting Performance Standards. Analysing deviations and taking corrective action already occurred, but since the outcome was still unachievable, standards themselves are being revisited.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (A) निष्पादन मानकों का निर्धारण है। जब सुधारात्मक कार्यवाही के बाद भी लक्ष्य प्राप्त न हो सकें तो मानकों को संशोधित करना नियंत्रण प्रक्रिया के पहले चरण (मानक निर्धारण) के अन्तर्गत आता है।

questions.text:
कथन – I : अभिप्रेरणा एक जटिल प्रक्रिया है क्योंकि मनुष्यों की अपेक्षाओं, अवबोधन तथा प्रतिक्रियाओं में भिन्नता होती है।
कथन – II : अभिप्रेरणा सकारात्मक भी हो सकती है और नकारात्मक भी।
निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
questions.text_english:
Statement – I : Motivation is a complex process as individuals are heterogeneous in their expectations, perceptions and reactions.
Statement – II : Motivation can be either positive or negative.
Choose the correct option from the following :

options.A: कथन I सत्य है तथा कथन II असत्य है।
options.B: कथन II सत्य है तथा कथन I असत्य है।
options.C: कथन I तथा कथन II दोनों सत्य हैं।
options.D: कथन I तथा कथन II दोनों असत्य हैं।

options_english.A: Statement I is true and Statement II is false.
options_english.B: Statement II is true and Statement I is false.
options_english.C: Both Statement I and Statement II are true.
options_english.D: Both Statement I and Statement II are false.

questions.solution: The correct answer is (C). Both statements are true. Motivation is indeed a complex process because every individual has different needs, expectations and reactions to incentives (Statement I is true). Motivation can be positive (rewards, praise) or negative (fear, threat of punishment) (Statement II is true). Neither statement contradicts the other, and both are well-established concepts in management theory.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (C) है। दोनों कथन सत्य हैं। अभिप्रेरणा जटिल है क्योंकि लोगों की अपेक्षाएँ और प्रतिक्रियाएँ अलग-अलग होती हैं, और यह सकारात्मक तथा नकारात्मक दोनों हो सकती है।

questions.text: एल्फा ग्राफिक्स लिमिटेड एक प्रसिद्ध भारतीय कम्पनी है जो बहुत वर्षों से इस व्यवसाय में है। कम्पनी का मुख्य कार्यकारी अधिकारी, रोहित गुप्ता सदैव व्यावसायिक पर्यावरण को समझने और साथ ही उसका उत्तर देने एवं उसे अपनाने में विश्वास रखता है। जब उसे पता चला कि एक विदेशी बहुराष्ट्रीय कम्पनी, लेनो ग्राफिक्स, भारतीय बाज़ार में इसके नए विकल्पों के साथ प्रवेश कर रही है तो उसने इस खतरे का सामना करने के लिए लागत में कमी करके तथा अच्छी गुणवत्ता वाले एवं सौन्दर्यात्मक रूप से आकर्षित करने वाले नक्शे, विज्ञापन, लोगोस इत्यादि तैयार किए। परिणामस्वरूप एल्फा ग्राफिक्स लिमिटेड न केवल अपने उपभोक्ताओं को बनाए रख सकी अपितु उसे नई परियोजनाएँ भी मिलने लगीं। उपरोक्त में चर्चित व्यावसायिक पर्यावरण के महत्त्व का बिन्दु है :
questions.text_english: Alfa Graphics Ltd. was a reputed Indian company which had been in business for many years. The Chief Executive Officer of the company, Rohit Gupta always believed in understanding the business environment as well as responding and adapting to it. When he found that a foreign multinational company, Leno Graphics, is entering the Indian market with new substitutes, he prepared to meet this threat by reducing cost and creating good quality and aesthetically appealing layouts, advertisements, logos etc. As a result, Alfa Graphics Ltd. was not only able to retain its own customers, but also started getting new projects. The point of importance of Business Environment discussed above is :

options.B: खतरे की पहचान एवं समय से पहले चेतावनी में सहायक
options.D: अवसरों की पहचान करने एवं पहल करने के लाभ

options_english.B: Identifying threats and early warning signals
options_english.D: Identifying opportunities and getting first mover advantage.

questions.solution: The correct answer is (B) Identifying threats and early warning signals. The case clearly shows that by understanding the business environment, Rohit Gupta was able to identify the threat of a foreign competitor entering the market early and took timely action to counter it. This is the importance of business environment that helps firms identify threats and get early warning signals to prepare in advance.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (B) खतरे की पहचान एवं समय से पहले चेतावनी में सहायक है। रोहित गुप्ता ने पर्यावरण को समझकर विदेशी प्रतिस्पर्धी के खतरे को समय से पहचाना और उचित कदम उठाए।

questions.text: संगठन कायों तथा तत्सम्बन्धित कर्त्तव्यों का स्पष्ट विवरण देता है। यह भ्रम एवं पुनरावृत्ति से बचाने में सहायता करता है। उपरोक्त चर्चित संगठन के महत्त्व का बिन्दु है :
questions.text_english: Organising provides a clear description of jobs and related duties. This helps to avoid confusion and duplication. The point of importance of organizing described above is :

options.B: प्रभावी प्रशासन
options.D: विकास एवं विस्तार

questions.solution: The correct answer is (B) Effective administration. When organising provides a clear description of jobs and duties and avoids confusion and duplication, it leads to effective administration. Clear job definitions ensure each person knows their role, preventing overlapping and ensuring smooth functioning of the organisation. Adaptation to change, development of personnel, and expansion relate to other aspects of organising.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (B) प्रभावी प्रशासन है। जब संगठन कार्यों का स्पष्ट विवरण देता है और भ्रम एवं पुनरावृत्ति से बचाता है तो यह प्रभावी प्रशासन में सहायक होता है।

questions.text:
कथन – I : कम्पनियों द्वारा अधिग्रहण हेतु बोलियों पर नियंत्रण भारतीय प्रतिभूति एवं विनिमय बोर्ड के नियमनकर्ता कायों में से एक है।
कथन – II : प्रतिभूति बाज़ार के मध्यस्थों का प्रशिक्षण भारतीय प्रतिभूति एवं विनिमय बोर्ड के विकासपूर्ण कायों में से एक है।
निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
questions.text_english:
Statement – I : Regulation of takeover bids by companies is one of the Regulatory functions of Securities and Exchange Board of India.
Statement – II : Training of intermediaries of securities market is one of the Development functions of Securities and Exchange Board of India.
Choose the correct option from the following :

options.A: कथन I सही है तथा कथन II गलत है।
options.B: कथन II सही है तथा कथन I गलत है।
options.C: कथन I तथा कथन II दोनों सही हैं।
options.D: कथन I तथा कथन II दोनों गलत हैं।

options_english.A: Statement I is correct and Statement II is incorrect.
options_english.B: Statement II is correct and Statement I is incorrect.
options_english.C: Both Statement I and Statement II are correct.
options_english.D: Both Statement I and Statement II are incorrect.

questions.solution: The correct answer is (C). Both statements are correct. Regulation of takeover bids is indeed a regulatory function of SEBI — it controls and regulates company takeovers to protect investor interests. Training of intermediaries such as brokers and sub-brokers is a developmental function of SEBI aimed at improving the efficiency of the securities market. Hence both statements are accurate.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (C) है। दोनों कथन सही हैं। अधिग्रहण बोलियों पर नियंत्रण SEBI का नियमनकर्ता कार्य है और मध्यस्थों का प्रशिक्षण SEBI का विकासपूर्ण कार्य है।

questions.text: 'उच्च दर की मूल्य वृद्धि का सामान्यत: व्यावसायिक उद्यमों पर दबाव पड़ता है क्योंकि यह व्यवसाय की विभिन्न लागतों में वृद्धि करते हैं जैसे कच्चे माल का क्रय तथा कर्मचारियों को मज़दूरी तथा वेतन का भुगतान इत्यादि।' उपरोक्त में चर्चित व्यावसायिक पर्यावरण का आयाम है :
questions.text_english: 'High inflation rates generally result in constraints on business enterprises as they increase the various costs of business such as the purchase of raw materials and payment of wages and salaries to employees etc.' The dimension of business environment referred to above is :

options.B: तकनीकी पर्यावरण
options.D: आर्थिक पर्यावरण

questions.solution: The correct answer is (D) Economic Environment. Inflation, interest rates, GDP growth rate, raw material prices, wages and salaries are all components of the economic environment. High inflation directly affects business costs and purchasing power. Political environment relates to government policies, technological to innovations, and social to cultural trends, so (A), (B), and (C) are incorrect.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (D) आर्थिक पर्यावरण है। मुद्रास्फीति, ब्याज दरें, कच्चे माल की कीमतें और वेतन आर्थिक पर्यावरण के घटक हैं।

questions.text: कॉलम – I में दी गई विपणन की अवधारणाओं का कॉलम – II में दी गई उनकी सम्बन्धित व्याख्या से मिलान कीजिए :
questions.text_english: Match the concepts of marketing in Column – I with their respective explanations in Column – II :
questions.instruction_line: कॉलम – I: (a) उत्पाद अवधारणा (b) विक्रय अवधारणा (c) विपणन अवधारणा (d) समाज अवधारणा | कॉलम – II: (i) उत्पाद की गुणवत्ता, निष्पादन एवं विशेषताओं पर केंद्रित (ii) उपभोक्ता आवश्यकताओं की संतुष्टि पर केंद्रित (iii) क्रेता को विद्यमान उत्पाद क्रय करने के लिए आक्रामक तरीके से तैयार करना (iv) उपभोक्ताओं की आवश्यकताओं की संतुष्टि एवं समाज कल्याण
questions.instruction_line_english: Column-I: (a) Product concept (b) Selling concept (c) Marketing concept (d) Societal concept | Column-II: (i) Its main focus is on quality, performance and feature of the product. (ii) Its main focus is on satisfaction of customer needs. (iii) Its main focus is on aggressively persuading buyer to purchase the existing product. (iv) Its main focus is on satisfaction of customer needs and society's well-being.
questions.solution: The correct answer is (D): (a)-(i), (b)-(iii), (c)-(ii), (d)-(iv). Product concept (a) focuses on quality, performance and features of the product — matched with (i). Selling concept (b) focuses on aggressively persuading buyers to purchase the existing product — matched with (iii). Marketing concept (c) focuses on satisfaction of customer needs — matched with (ii). Societal concept (d) focuses on customer needs satisfaction along with society's well-being — matched with (iv).
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (D) है। उत्पाद अवधारणा-(i), विक्रय अवधारणा-(iii), विपणन अवधारणा-(ii), समाज अवधारणा-(iv)।

questions.text: साधना, एक प्रसिद्ध प्रबन्ध संस्थान से स्नातक है तथा एक सफल प्रबन्धक है। वह अपने प्राप्त ज्ञान का उपयोग कार्य की कठिन परिस्थितियों में व्यक्तिगत एवं कौशलपूर्ण तरीके से करती है। इन परिस्थितियों का सामना करने के लिए वह अपनी कल्पनाशक्ति एवं रचनात्मकता का उपयोग करती है। उपरोक्त स्थिति में प्रबन्ध की प्रकृति के जिस पहलू पर प्रकाश डाला गया है, वह है :
questions.text_english: Sadhna, a graduate of a reputed institute of management, is a successful manager. She applies her acquired knowledge in a personalised and skillful manner in difficult situations at work. She uses her imagination and creativity in handling these situations. The aspect of the nature of management highlighted in the above case is :

options.A: प्रबन्ध एक कला के रूप में
options.B: प्रबन्ध एक विज्ञान के रूप में
options.C: प्रबन्ध एक पेशे के रूप में
options.D: प्रबन्ध एक विज्ञान एवं एक पेशे दोनों के रूप में

options_english.D: Management both as a Science and as a Profession

questions.solution: The correct answer is (A) Management as an Art. Art involves application of knowledge in a personalised, creative, and skillful manner. Sadhna applies her acquired management knowledge creatively and skillfully in difficult situations using imagination — these are characteristics of art. Management as a science involves systematic study, as a profession involves formal qualification and ethical code, so (B), (C), and (D) are incorrect in this context.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (A) प्रबन्ध एक कला के रूप में है। कला में ज्ञान का व्यक्तिगत, रचनात्मक एवं कौशलपूर्ण उपयोग होता है, जो साधना के मामले में स्पष्ट है।

questions.text: 'प्रबन्ध के सिद्धान्तों में परिस्थित की माँग के अनुसार प्रबन्धक सुधार कर सकते हैं।' यह कथन प्रबन्ध के सिद्धान्तों की निम्नलिखित में से किस विशेषता पर प्रकाश डालता है :
questions.text_english: 'The principles of management can be modified by the managers when the situation so demands.' This highlights which of the following feature of principles of management :

options.B: लोच
options.D: मुख्यत: व्यावहारिक

questions.solution: The correct answer is (B) Flexible. The statement that managers can modify principles of management according to the demands of the situation highlights the flexible nature of management principles. Unlike laws of science that are rigid, management principles can be adapted and modified to suit different situations. They are not absolute but serve as flexible guidelines for managers.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (B) लोच है। प्रबन्ध के सिद्धान्त लचीले होते हैं क्योंकि प्रबन्धक परिस्थितियों के अनुसार उनमें सुधार कर सकते हैं।

questions.text:
पी. माधव एक फर्म 'ट्रेंडी स्टाइल प्राइवेट लिमिटेड' के उत्पादन प्रबन्धक हैं, जो ऑफिस फर्नीचर का उत्पादन करती है। उसका उद्देश्य अगले एक वर्ष में उत्पादन को 20% बढ़ाना है। लेकिन विक्रय प्रबन्धक, आर. शेटी तब तक उत्पादन में वृद्धि की अनुमति नहीं देते जब तक लकड़ी की गुणवत्ता, तालों व हैंडल इत्यादि में नवीनतम प्रचलनों को सम्मिलित कर परिवर्तन नहीं लाए जाते। इस प्रकार का टकराव प्रबन्ध की एक महत्त्वपूर्ण अवधारणा को प्रकाश में लाता है जो विभिन्न विभागों की गतिविधियों में एक कड़ी का कार्य करने में सहायता कर सकता है।
(i) उपरोक्त चर्चित अवधारणा को पहचानिए एवं समझाइए।
(ii) उपरोक्त (i) में पहचानी गई अवधारणा के महत्त्व के किन्हीं दो बिंदुओं का उल्लेख कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
P. Madhav is the production manager of 'Trendy Style Pvt. Ltd.', a firm manufacturing office furniture. His objective is to increase production by 20% in the next one year. But the Sales Manager, R. Shetty does not approve of the increase in production, till changes are brought about in the quality of wood, locks, handles etc. to incorporate latest trends. This kind of conflict brings to light an important concept of management that can help to link the activities of various departments.
(i) Identify and explain the concept discussed above.
(ii) State any two points of importance of the concept identified in (i) above.

sub_questions.text: उपरोक्त चर्चित अवधारणा को पहचानिए एवं समझाइए।
sub_questions.text_english: Identify and explain the concept discussed above.

key_points: The concept is Coordination
Coordination is the process of synchronising the activities of different departments towards common goals
It acts as a binding force that integrates all managerial functions

sub_questions.solution: The concept discussed is Coordination. Coordination is the process by which a manager synchronises the activities of different individuals and departments so that they work together towards the achievement of organisational goals. It acts as the binding force that integrates all managerial functions and ensures unity of action across all departments.

sub_questions.text: उपरोक्त (i) में पहचानी गई अवधारणा के महत्त्व के किन्हीं दो बिंदुओं का उल्लेख कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: State any two points of importance of the concept identified in (i) above.

key_points: Growth in the size of the organisation: As an organisation grows, coordination becomes essential to link the activities of more departments
Specialisation: When different departments have specialised functions, coordination ensures their efforts are integrated and not conflicting

sub_questions.solution: First, coordination is important for growth in the size of the organisation — as the number of departments increases, coordination ensures all activities are aligned towards common goals. Second, coordination is vital due to specialisation — when the production and sales departments each have their own specialised goals, coordination prevents conflict and ensures both departments work in harmony for overall organisational success.

key_points: Concept: Coordination
Explanation of coordination as a binding force between departments
Importance: Growth in size and Specialisation

questions.solution: The concept discussed in this case is Coordination. Coordination is the process of synchronising the activities of various departments of an organisation so that they all work in unison towards achieving the common organisational goals. In this case, the production manager wants to increase output while the sales manager wants quality improvements first — coordination would align these differing departmental views. Two important points of coordination are: (1) Growth in the size of organisation — as firms grow, more departments are created, making coordination essential to link all activities. (2) Specialisation — different departments develop specialised functions, and without coordination these specialised efforts can lead to conflict and disunity.

sub_questions.text_english: Give meaning of 'Communication'. State first two elements in the process of communication.

key_points: Communication is the process of exchange of information, ideas, facts and opinions between two or more persons
First element: Sender — the person who initiates the communication
Second element: Message — the information, idea or fact to be communicated

sub_questions.solution: Communication is the process of passing information and understanding from one person to another through meaningful symbols. It involves exchange of ideas, opinions and facts between two or more persons. The first two elements in the process of communication are: (1) Sender — the person who initiates the communication by encoding a message; and (2) Message — the content, idea, information or feeling that the sender wishes to convey to the receiver.

sub_questions.text_english: State any three 'Organisational barriers' to Communication.

key_points: Organisational Policy — if communication policy does not support free flow of information
Rules and Regulations — rigid rules and procedures may restrict communication
Status — hierarchical differences create psychological barriers between seniors and subordinates

sub_questions.solution: Three organisational barriers to communication are: (1) Organisational Policy — if the organisational policy does not clearly support a free flow of information, it hampers effective communication. (2) Rules and Regulations — rigid and inflexible rules and procedures can create obstacles in the smooth flow of communication. (3) Status — when there are large status differences between superiors and subordinates, subordinates may hesitate to communicate freely, which distorts the communication process.

questions.text_english: Madhwan was appointed as a Human Resource Manager in 'Health Grow Ltd.' six months back. As a Human Resource Manager, he has to perform many specialised activities and duties like analyzing jobs by collecting information about jobs and prepare job descriptions, training and development of employees etc. State three other specialized activities that Madhwan must perform in addition to the above as a Human Resource Manager of Health Grow Ltd.

key_points: Recruitment and selection of employees
Performance appraisal
Compensation and wage administration

questions.solution: Three other specialised activities that Madhwan must perform as a Human Resource Manager of Health Grow Ltd. are: (1) Recruitment and Selection — identifying and hiring suitable candidates for various job positions in the organisation through a systematic process. (2) Performance Appraisal — evaluating the performance of employees against set standards to provide feedback and decide on promotions, increments or training needs. (3) Compensation Management — designing and administering the wage and salary structure, incentives and benefits to attract, retain and motivate employees.

sub_questions.text_english: State any three points of importance of Financial Planning.

key_points: Ensures availability of adequate funds at the right time
Helps in coordinating various business activities
Reduces uncertainty and avoids financial shocks

sub_questions.solution: Three points of importance of Financial Planning are: (1) It ensures adequate and timely availability of funds — financial planning ensures that the right amount of funds is available at the right time to meet business requirements. (2) It helps in coordinating different business activities — by preparing a financial plan, the activities of production, sales and purchase are harmonised. (3) It reduces financial uncertainty — financial planning anticipates future financial needs and takes steps in advance, thereby reducing the impact of financial shocks on the business.

(2) Scale of Operations — a large-scale firm needs more fixed capital as it requires more machinery and infrastructure compared to a small-scale firm. (3) Technology Used — firms using capital-intensive technology require more fixed capital investment in machinery as opposed to labour-intensive industries.

sub_questions.text: प्रबन्ध के 'निर्देशन' कार्य के महत्त्व के किन्हीं चार बिन्दुओं का उल्लेख कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: State any four points of importance of 'Directing' function of Management.

key_points: Initiates action
Integrates employee efforts
Means of motivation
Facilitates change

sub_questions.solution: Four points of importance of the Directing function of management are: (1) Initiates Action — directing is the function that actually initiates the implementation of plans. It converts plans into actual performance by guiding employees on what to do and how to do it. (2) Integrates Employee Efforts — directing integrates the efforts of all employees towards the achievement of organisational goals by creating a team spirit and coordinating individual contributions. (3) Means of Motivation — through directing, managers motivate employees using financial and non-financial incentives, which boosts morale and productivity. (4) Facilitates Change — directing helps in overcoming employees' resistance to change by explaining the need for change and guiding them through the transition process effectively.

sub_questions.text: भर्ती के आन्तरिक स्रोतों की किन्हीं चार सीमाओं का उल्लेख कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: State any four limitations of internal sources of recruitment.

key_points: Prevents inflow of fresh talent
Creates a feeling of discontent among those not promoted
Limited choice
Promotes inbreeding

sub_questions.solution: Four limitations of internal sources of recruitment are: (1) Prevents Inflow of Fresh Talent — since employees are recruited from within the organisation, there is no opportunity to bring in new talent with fresh ideas and perspectives, which can limit innovation. (2) Creates Feeling of Discontent — employees who are not promoted or selected may develop a feeling of jealousy and dissatisfaction, affecting their morale and productivity. (3) Limited Choice — the organisation has to choose from a limited pool of existing employees, which may mean that the best candidate for a position is not available internally. (4) Promotes Inbreeding — repeated internal promotions limit exposure to external practices and lead to a narrow-minded approach, as employees are accustomed to only the internal environment of the organisation.

sub_questions.text_english: Explain the following external sources of recruitment : (i) Direct Recruitment (ii) Casual Callers

key_points: Direct Recruitment: Placing a notice at the factory gate inviting applications from interested candidates
Casual Callers: Maintaining a database of unsolicited applications received and using them when vacancies arise

sub_questions.solution: Direct Recruitment, also known as factory gate recruitment, involves placing a notice at the factory gate specifying the number and type of personnel required. Interested candidates apply directly without any intermediary. This method is suitable for unskilled or semi-skilled workers and is cost-effective and simple. Casual Callers refers to the practice of maintaining a database or a waiting list of candidates who have submitted their applications on their own initiative without any advertisement. When a vacancy arises, the organisation contacts suitable candidates from this list. This saves time and recruitment costs, and the candidates are already interested in working for the organisation.

sub_questions.text_english: Explain the following non-financial incentives which motivate employees for higher performance : (i) Employee participation (ii) Organisational climate

key_points: Employee participation: involving employees in decision-making enhances their sense of belonging and commitment
Organisational climate: the overall work environment and culture that shapes employee attitudes and motivation

sub_questions.solution: Employee Participation refers to involving employees in the decision-making process, especially on matters that directly affect them. When employees are given the opportunity to express their views and participate in planning, they develop a sense of belonging, ownership and responsibility towards their work. This significantly boosts their morale and motivation to perform at a higher level. Organisational Climate refers to the overall work atmosphere or environment of an organisation, including factors like management's attitude, openness of communication, autonomy given to employees, and recognition of efforts. A positive organisational climate where employees feel respected, valued and supported encourages them to give their best performance and remain committed to the organisation.

questions.text: आभा के घर पर मेहमान थे। उसने 'बिरयानी हाऊस' से शाकाहारी बिरयानी का आदेश दिया। बिरयानी एक सुंदर पैकेजिंग में आई और आभा ने इसे बहुत अधिक उत्सुकता के साथ खोला। लेकिन जब उसने मेहमानों को बिरयानी परोसनी आरंभ की, उसे लगा कि यह मांसाहारी बिरयानी थी। उसने पैकेज को जाँचा और यह पाया कि उसके ऊपर ऐसा कोई संकेत नहीं था कि यह बिरयानी शाकाहारी है या मांसाहारी। उसने इसके लिए 'बिरयानी हाऊस' से सम्पर्क किया। 'बिरयानी हाऊस' के मैनेजर ने इसके लिए क्षमा माँगी और एक शाकाहारी बिरयानी अतिरिक्त मिठान के साथ तुरंत भेज दी। उपरोक्त स्थिति में चर्चित दो उपभोक्ता अधिकारों को पहचानिए एवं समझाइए।
questions.text_english: Abha had guests at home. She ordered vegetable biryani from 'Biryani House'. The biryani came in a beautiful packaging and Abha opened it with lot of excitement. However, when she started serving biryani to the guests, she realised that it was non-vegetarian. She checked the package and noticed that there was no indication whether it was a vegetarian or non-vegetarian biryani. She contacted 'Biryani House' for the same. The manager at 'Biryani House' apologized and immediately sent a vegetarian biryani along with complimentary sweet dish. Identify and explain the two consumer rights discussed in the above case.

key_points: Right to be Informed — consumer has the right to receive complete information about the product including vegetarian/non-vegetarian nature
Right to be Heard — consumer has the right to file a complaint and receive a response/redressal from the seller

questions.solution: The two consumer rights discussed in this case are: (1) Right to be Informed — this right means that consumers are entitled to receive accurate and complete information about the product they purchase, including its ingredients, quality, quantity, and nature (e.g., vegetarian or non-vegetarian). In this case, the packaging of the biryani did not indicate whether it was vegetarian or non-vegetarian, which is a violation of this right. (2) Right to Seek Redressal — this right means that a consumer has the right to file a complaint against unfair trade practices and receive appropriate compensation or remedy. When Abha contacted Biryani House, the manager apologised and sent a replacement biryani with a complimentary sweet dish, thus fulfilling this right of the consumer.

'Tech Work' an Artificial Intelligence (AI) startup started in 2024. It was earning good profits. It wanted to expand its business and for its research and development, it required ₹ 100 crores. The Chief Executive Officer of 'Tech Work' consulted the Finance Manager who suggested that there is a market which facilitates transfer of investible funds from savers to entrepreneurs seeking to establish new enterprises or expand existing ones through the issue of securities. The management of 'Tech Work' decided to raise funds from the investors by issuing equity shares @ ₹ 200 per share for the first time.
(i) Name the type of capital market through which 'Tech Work' decided to raise funds for its expansion.
(ii) State three features of the market identified in (i) above.

sub_questions.text: पूँजी बाज़ार के उस प्रकार का नाम बताइए जिसके माध्यम से 'टैक वर्क' ने अपने व्यवसाय के विस्तार के लिए कोषों को जुटाने का निर्णय लिया।
sub_questions.text_english: Name the type of capital market through which 'Tech Work' decided to raise funds for its expansion.

key_points: Primary Market (also called New Issue Market)

sub_questions.solution: The type of capital market is the Primary Market (also known as the New Issue Market). Tech Work is issuing equity shares for the first time to raise fresh capital, which is a characteristic feature of the primary market where new securities are issued directly to investors.

sub_questions.text: उपरोक्त (i) में पहचाने गए बाज़ार की किन्हीं तीन विशेषताओं का उल्लेख कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: State three features of the market identified in (i) above.

key_points: It deals with new securities being offered to the public for the first time
It provides funds directly to companies for fresh investment
Securities can be issued through public issue, offer for sale, private placement etc.

sub_questions.solution: Three features of the Primary Market are: (1) It deals with New Securities — the primary market is a market for new securities that are being offered to the public for the first time, enabling companies to raise fresh capital. (2) Direct Flow of Funds — funds raised through the primary market flow directly from investors to the issuing company, making it a market for direct finance. (3) Various Methods of Flotation — companies can raise funds in the primary market through different methods such as Initial Public Offering (IPO), offer for sale, and private placement.

key_points: Primary Market
Deals with new securities
Direct flow of funds to companies
Various flotation methods

questions.solution: The type of capital market is the Primary Market. Three features of the Primary Market are: (1) It deals with new securities — only new securities that are being issued for the first time are traded here. (2) Funds flow directly to companies — investible funds are transferred directly from savers/investors to the issuing company, providing fresh capital for business expansion. (3) Various methods of issue — companies can approach the primary market through methods like Initial Public Offering (IPO), private placement, or offer for sale.

गणेश जैन 'के एल फूड्स लिमिटेड' में विपणन प्रबन्धक है। उसके पास चार कर्मचारियों का एक समूह है जो उसके अधीन कार्य करता है – काव्या, रितेश, पूजा तथा माधव। काव्या तथा रितेश अस्थायी कर्मचारी हैं जबकि पूजा तथा माधव की नौकरी स्थायी है। ये चारों बहुत मेहनत से कार्य कर रहे हैं और लगातार अपने लक्ष्यों को प्राप्त कर रहे हैं। गणेश जैन उनके अच्छे निष्पादन के लिए उन्हें पुरस्कृत करना चाहता है। वह समझता है कि सभी मनुष्यों में आवश्यकताओं का एक अनुक्रम विद्यमान होता है। अत: उसने प्रत्येक कर्मचारी की आवश्यकता के स्तर को पहचाना ताकि वह उन्हें अभिप्रेरित कर सके। एक अच्छी पैंशन योजना के साथ काव्या और रितेश की नौकरी स्थायी कर दी गई जबकि पूजा तथा माधव को स्वायत्त सत्ता दे दी गई।
(i) उपरोक्त स्थिति में गणेश जैन द्वारा अभिज्ञात की गई कर्मचारियों की आवश्यकताओं को पहचानिए एवं उनका उल्लेख कीजिए।
(ii) ऐसी किन्हीं दो मान्यताओं का उल्लेख कीजिए जिस पर मास्लो का आवश्यकता-क्रमबद्धता सिद्धान्त आधारित है।
questions.text_english:
Ganesh Jain is the Marketing Manager at 'KL Foods Ltd'. He has a team of four employees working under him – Kavya, Ritesh, Pooja and Madhav. Kavya and Ritesh are temporary employees while Pooja and Madhav's job is permanent. All four of them have been working hard and consistently met all targets. Ganesh Jain wanted to reward them for their good performance. He understood that in all human beings, there exists a hierarchy of needs. So, he identified the need level of each of the employees to provide motivation to them. Kavya and Ritesh were made permanent in the job with a good pension plan while Pooja and Madhav were given an autonomy status.
(i) Identify and state the need of employees recognized by Ganesh Jain in the above case.
(ii) State any two assumptions on which Maslow's Need Hierarchy Theory is based on.

sub_questions.text: उपरोक्त स्थिति में गणेश जैन द्वारा अभिज्ञात की गई कर्मचारियों की आवश्यकताओं को पहचानिए एवं उनका उल्लेख कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Identify and state the need of employees recognized by Ganesh Jain in the above case.

key_points: Kavya and Ritesh: Safety/Security needs — permanent job with pension plan fulfils their need for job security
Pooja and Madhav: Self-actualisation needs — autonomy status fulfils their need to reach their full potential

sub_questions.solution: Ganesh Jain recognised two types of needs. For Kavya and Ritesh, he identified Safety and Security needs — as temporary employees, they needed job security. Making them permanent with a pension plan fulfils their security needs (protection from future risks). For Pooja and Madhav, who already had permanent jobs, Ganesh Jain identified Self-Actualisation needs — giving them autonomy allows them to work independently, fulfil their potential, and achieve personal growth, which is the highest level in Maslow's hierarchy.

sub_questions.text: ऐसी किन्हीं दो मान्यताओं का उल्लेख कीजिए जिस पर मास्लो का आवश्यकता-क्रमबद्धता सिद्धान्त आधारित है।
sub_questions.text_english: State any two assumptions on which Maslow's Need Hierarchy Theory is based on.

key_points: Human behaviour is determined by their unsatisfied needs
Needs are arranged in a hierarchical order from lower to higher levels

sub_questions.solution: Two assumptions on which Maslow's Need Hierarchy Theory is based are: (1) Human behaviour is goal-directed — people are motivated by their unsatisfied needs, and once a need is satisfied it no longer motivates behaviour; they then move to the next higher level need. (2) Needs are arranged in a hierarchical order — needs are classified into five levels starting from physiological needs at the bottom to self-actualisation at the top, and a person moves to the next level only after the lower level need is substantially satisfied.

key_points: Kavya and Ritesh: Security needs
Pooja and Madhav: Self-actualisation needs
Assumption 1: Behaviour is driven by unsatisfied needs
Assumption 2: Needs are hierarchical

questions.solution: Ganesh Jain identified Security needs for Kavya and Ritesh (temporary employees given permanent jobs with pension — fulfils safety and security), and Self-Actualisation needs for Pooja and Madhav (permanent employees given autonomy — fulfils the need to reach one's full potential). Two assumptions of Maslow's theory are: (1) behaviour is motivated by unsatisfied needs, and (2) needs are arranged in a hierarchical order from basic physiological needs at the bottom to self-actualisation at the top.

(ii) ऐसे दो अन्य घटकों का उल्लेख कीजिए जो एक कम्पनी के लाभांश निर्णय को प्रभावित करते हैं।
questions.text_english:
VK Ltd. is a fast moving consumer goods company. It has shareholders spread all over India. Most of its shareholders depend upon a regular income from their investment. VK Ltd. has been earning consistent profits. The management of the company keeps in mind the preference of the shareholders regarding payment of dividend. Since its shareholders, in general, desire that atleast a certain amount is paid as dividend to them every year, the company declares dividend every year. Atul, the Finance Manager of the company identified promising growth opportunities. He suggested to the Chief Executive Officer to retain the earnings to finance the required investments instead of declaring dividend every year. For this, the Chief Executive Officer decided to call a General Body Meeting of the shareholders.
(i) Identify two factors affecting dividend decision discussed above.
(ii) State two other factors that affect the dividend decision of a company.

sub_questions.text: उपरोक्त चर्चित लाभांश निर्णय को प्रभावित करने वाले दो घटकों को पहचानिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Identify two factors affecting dividend decision discussed above.

key_points: Shareholder preference — shareholders desire regular dividend income
Growth opportunities — need to retain earnings for financing investment

sub_questions.solution: Two factors affecting dividend decision discussed in the case are: (1) Shareholder Preference — the shareholders of VK Ltd. depend on regular income from their investment and desire that at least a fixed amount is paid as dividend every year. This influences the company to declare dividends regularly. (2) Growth Opportunities — Atul identified promising growth opportunities that require investment. To finance these, earnings need to be retained rather than distributed as dividend, which is a factor working against dividend payment.

sub_questions.text: ऐसे दो अन्य घटकों का उल्लेख कीजिए जो एक कम्पनी के लाभांश निर्णय को प्रभावित करते हैं।
sub_questions.text_english: State two other factors that affect the dividend decision of a company.

key_points: Earnings — higher earnings support higher dividend payments
Stability of earnings — companies with stable earnings tend to pay regular dividends

sub_questions.solution: Two other factors affecting dividend decision are: (1) Earnings — dividend is paid out of current and past profits. If a company has higher and stable earnings, it can afford to pay higher dividends. A company with low or inconsistent profits will be cautious about declaring dividends. (2) Taxation Policy — if the dividend tax rate is high, the company may prefer to retain earnings and reward shareholders through buybacks or capital appreciation rather than paying out dividends.

key_points: Shareholder preference
Growth opportunities
Earnings
Taxation policy

questions.solution: Two factors discussed in the case are shareholder preference (regular income dependency) and growth opportunities (need to retain earnings for investment). Two other factors are earnings (higher profits enable higher dividends) and taxation policy (high dividend tax may discourage dividend declaration in favour of retained earnings).

sub_questions.text_english: Explain the following principles of General Management : (i) Scalar chain (ii) Equity (iii) Initiative

key_points: Scalar Chain: line of authority from top to bottom
Equity: combination of kindness and justice in treating employees
Initiative: employees should be encouraged to take initiative within limits

sub_questions.solution: Scalar Chain refers to the formal line of authority from the highest to the lowest level in an organisation. All communications should follow this chain. However, in urgent situations, a 'Gang Plank' can be used, which is a direct horizontal communication between employees at the same level without going through the entire chain. Equity means that managers should be kind and just while dealing with subordinates. There should be no discrimination on the basis of caste, gender or religion, and all employees should be treated equally and fairly to gain their loyalty. Initiative means that employees should be encouraged to take initiatives and develop plans on their own. Giving employees the freedom to initiate ideas within the limits of authority boosts their morale and brings out the best in them. Fayol considered initiative one of the keenest satisfactions for a person of intelligence.

sub_questions.text_english: 'Objectives of Management can be classified into organisational, social and personal objectives.' Explain these objectives.

key_points: Organisational objectives: survival, profit, growth
Social objectives: quality goods at fair prices, employment generation, environmental protection
Personal objectives: fair salaries, personal growth, recognition

sub_questions.solution: Organisational Objectives are those that help the organisation survive and grow. These include survival (ensuring the organisation continues to exist by earning enough revenue), profit (generating sufficient returns to cover risks and finance expansion), and growth (increasing the size of operations, market share, and profitability over time). Social Objectives are concerned with the well-being of society. Management must provide quality goods at reasonable prices, generate employment opportunities, contribute to the environment through pollution control measures, and support community development. Personal Objectives relate to the needs of individual employees. Management should ensure fair remuneration for employees, provide opportunities for personal development and career growth, recognise employee contributions, and maintain a healthy work environment so that employees remain motivated and committed.

sub_questions.text_english: Explain the following points of importance of 'Planning' function of management : (i) Planning provides directions. (ii) Planning promotes innovative ideas. (iii) Planning reduces the risk of uncertainty.

key_points: Planning provides directions by stating goals and coordinating all activities
Planning promotes innovative ideas as managers must think creatively to identify best alternatives
Planning reduces uncertainty by anticipating future events and preparing responses in advance

sub_questions.solution: Planning Provides Directions means that planning determines in advance what is to be done and how. By stating the objectives clearly, all managers and employees know in which direction to concentrate their efforts, thus ensuring unity of purpose and avoiding aimless activities. Planning Promotes Innovative Ideas means that planning requires managers to think ahead, evaluate alternatives, and develop creative solutions. The planning process encourages original thinking as managers must consider new and better ways to achieve goals, fostering an environment of innovation. Planning Reduces the Risk of Uncertainty means that future is always uncertain, but planning helps organisations to anticipate future challenges and prepare strategies in advance. By forecasting potential risks and developing contingency plans, management is better equipped to deal with unforeseen events, thereby reducing the adverse impact of uncertainty.

sub_questions.text: उद्देश्य, नियम एवं बजट को योजना के प्रकारों के रूप में समझाइए।
sub_questions.text_english: Explain 'Objectives', 'Rule' and 'Budget' as types of plans.

key_points: Objectives: specific, measurable goals to be achieved in a time period
Rules: specific statements about what should or should not be done in a given situation
Budget: a numerical statement of expected results for a specific period

sub_questions.solution: Objectives are the ends towards which all activities of an organisation are directed. They are specific, measurable targets to be achieved within a defined time period. For example, a company may set an objective of increasing sales by 15% in a year. Objectives provide a sense of direction and serve as the foundation for all other plans. Rules are specific, definitive statements that prescribe what must or must not be done in a given situation. They are inflexible plans with no room for discretion, such as 'No smoking on premises.' Rules ensure uniformity of behaviour and help maintain discipline. Budget is a numerical statement expressing the expected results in financial or non-financial terms for a specified future period. It serves as both a planning tool and a control device. For example, a sales budget states expected revenue, while a production budget specifies planned output quantities.

questions.text: यात्रियों की गतिशीलता को बढ़ाने के लिए डी जी लिमिटेड ने, जो एक ई-प्लेन कार कम्पनी है, एक उड़ने वाली क्रान्तिकारी कार विकसित की है। यह हाइब्रिड उड़ने वाली कार दो व्यक्तियों के अनुरूप है और सुविधाजनक प्रवेश के लिए इसके दरवाजे की तरह अभिनव पंख जैसी विशेषताएँ हैं। सीटों को अत्यधिक सुविधाजनक ढंग से उच्च गुणवत्ता वाली सामग्री से डिज़ाइन किया गया है। इस उड़ने वाली कार की विशिष्ट विशेषता यह है कि इसका निर्माण भारत में किया जाएगा और यह इलेक्ट्रिसिटी (बिजली) के साथ-साथ जैव-ईंधन का उपयोग भी करेगी और परिवहन के स्थायी साधन को आश्वस्त करेगी। इस श्रेणी में डी जी लिमिटेड को प्रथम परीक्षण स्वीकृति मिल गई है। इसकी कीमत ₹ 2.5 करोड़ निश्चित की गई है, कम्पनी को अभी उपभोक्ताओं को छूट तथा उधार शर्तों इत्यादि के बारे में निर्णय लेने हैं ताकि उपभोक्ता कीमत को उत्पादन के मूल्य के साथ देख सकें। उड़ने वाली कार को लक्षित उपभोक्ताओं को उपलब्ध कराने के लिए डी जी लिमिटेड उन विक्रेताओं अथवा मध्यस्थों के चयन तथा मध्यस्थों को सहायता इत्यादि प्रदान करने की प्रक्रिया में है जो उपभोक्ताओं तक पहुँच सकते हैं। लक्षित उपभोक्ताओं तक उत्पाद की उपलब्धता, विशेषताएँ, लाभ इत्यादि पहुँचाने तथा उन्हें उड़ने वाली कार क्रय करने के लिए अभिप्रेरित करने के लिए डी जी लिमिटेड ने यह निर्णय लिया है कि वह डिजिटल विपणन अभियान, प्रेस विज्ञप्ति तथा प्रभावशाली व्यक्तियों एवं पत्रकारों द्वारा प्रदर्शनों का आयोजन करेगी। उपरोक्त स्थिति में डी जी लिमिटेड द्वारा अपनी बाज़ार प्रस्तुति को तैयार करने के लिए उपयोग में लाए गए घटकों के एक संयोजन की चर्चा की गई है। उपर्युक्त अनुच्छेद से पंक्तियाँ उद्धृत करते हुए घटकों को पहचानिए एवं समझाइए।
